notes.title: Procedural Generation Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!Procedurally generated level have been upgraded!

🧩 Procedural Generation now has more variety, biomasses and darkness!
The generation have been made more dense and creepy. The level from now on, grows out biomasses and progressively gets more and more dark as you progress through, adding more intensity to the level.

The items are now spawning more randomly through the level adding more variety to their locations.

The item markers also got smaller, so now it is not as easy to find the solution as before! 

Hunt mode related UI have been improved.


💬 As Always, I Need Your Feedback!
Procedural generation is a huge step forward for the game, and I want to make sure it feels just right. It is in a really early stage but is already a huge improvement in terms of mechanics, that I plan to improve much more. If it goes well, it will make the levels much more unpredictable.

Let me know how it plays for you, what works, and what needs tweaking. Post your thoughts on the Steam forums, or join the Backrooms Media Discord server!


🤝 Join the Community!
If you’d like to talk about the game, report bugs, or just hang out with other players, join the Backrooms Media Discord server! Your feedback is incredibly important in shaping the game, and I always appreciate hearing from you!  Looking forward to sharing more info soon!  



Thank you all for the continued support and for being part of this journey!

— Patrik

notes.title: New Update: The Deadly Hunt Begins!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

A brand new game mode has arrived, bringing fresh objectives, mechanics, and intense new challenges! This time, your mission is simple but terrifying: capture one of the entities roaming the Backrooms. At any cost.

To help you survive this dangerous expedition, I’ve introduced five new traps, each designed to give you a fighting chance.

🛠️ New Tools & Traps
🔍 Radar – Detects all lifeforms around you, both friend and foe.
🎭 Decoy – Toss it to lure the entity away. But be careful - it won’t fool them forever.
🚨 Sensor – Alerts you when something passes through its range.
⚡ Stopping Shocker – A last resort to stun the entity and buy yourself precious seconds.
❌ Deterrent – Scares the entity away… but for how long?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/ac29bffb26b4dbb39a924cdb789f323ac0b121cc.gif

🔧 New Controls for a Smoother Experience
I've also made adjustments to the controls to improve gameplay and make every encounter even more immersive.

💬 Let Me Know What You Think!
I’d love to hear your thoughts on the new game mode and whether this feels like the right direction for the game. If you come across any bugs or have any suggestions, please share them on the Steam forums or join the Backrooms Media Discord server. You can also fill out a short feedback form to let me know what you think about the new game mode. Every bit of input helps!

Thank you for your support! I hope you enjoy this new hunt. Stay safe… and make sure you catch the entity before it catches you.

— Patrik

notes.title: December Update is Out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

First off, thank you for your feedback and support as always. As promised, I have another update for you!

⭐ What’s New?
This month, I focused on reworking the Parking Lot level, but that’s not all! Here’s what’s new:

☢️ Parking Lot Revamp:
[olist]
 New Models: I’ve added fresh environmental details and a brand-new card reader to help you find the exit door more easily
 New Layout: The Parking Lot level has been redesigned with new areas for you to explore
[/olist]
☢️ Sound Enhancements:
[olist]
 Flashlights now have sounds when toggled
 Player damage sounds have been updated
 The Smiler now comes with its own creepy sound
[/olist]
☢️ Monster Speed Adjustments:
[olist]
 Monsters on Level 0 have had their speed rebalanced—they’ll no longer charge at you with superspeed
[/olist]
☢️ Bug Fixes:
[olist]
 Various fixes to improve your gameplay experience
 Fixed a bug causing workshop levels to not appear
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/b22441d2b51e60d9865b2cc40a495728a2befd2e.gif

🎮 About the New Game Mode
In an earlier devlog, I mentioned that a new game mode was planned for this December. I’ve decided to postpone its release because it’s just not ready yet. I want to make sure it’s in a good state before sharing it with you all.

That said, I’m eager to gather your feedback on it! I’m planning to release the game mode on the experimental branch first, possibly in January, and may even organize broader playtests to see if it’s heading in the right direction. Keep an eye out for more news on this soon!

🎁 Holiday Break
As the holiday season approaches, the weekly devlogs will pause for a short break and return in the second week of January. I’ll also be taking this time to rest and recharge.

I hope you all have a wonderful holiday season and an amazing start to 2025. Thank you so much for your support throughout 2024, it meant the world to me. I’m super excited for what’s coming next, and I can’t wait to share more updates with you in the new year!

Take care and see you in 2025 🎉

— Patrik

notes.title: November Update Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Patrik here again, bringing you another update for Backrooms Media! Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game into something we can be proud of, and I’m very excited to share what’s new and improved in this update. Let’s jump in!

⭐ What’s New?
This time, the update focuses on leveling up the overall experience, addressing networking issues, and introducing some spooky surprises. Here's what you can expect:

☢️ Networking Improvements:
[olist]
 No more fatal errors when connecting to multiplayer games
 You no longer need to switch servers on Steam to join your friends—connecting is now seamless
 Overall, the connection is much more stable and reliable
[/olist]
⚠️ If you were using Backrooms Media version 1.1.6 or earlier, you may need to navigate to C:/Users/[Your Username]/AppData/Local/BackroomsMedia/Saved/Config/Windows and delete the "Engine.ini" file to ensure the game runs after this update.

☢️ Uplifting of DeepInLevel0:
[olist]
 Updated textures and models for a more immersive environment
 Reworked the layout of walls and columns for better navigation
 Monsters can no longer get stuck at the last doors
 New jumpscare: Beware of the walls… you’ve been warned 👻
[/olist]
☢️ Revamped Bacteria Monster:
[olist]
 Fresh, terrifying look
 Enhanced animations for a more realistic scare factor
[/olist]
☢️ Menu & Settings:
[olist]
 Added the ability to exit the menu by pressing ESC
 Unified settings for a consistent experience across the game
[/olist]
☢️ Player & Monster Enhancements:
[olist]
 Adjusted movement speed for both players and monsters to enhance the pacing
 Smoother and more consistent transitions between levels
 Enemies now spawn randomly throughout the levels—keep your wits about you
 Hazmat Suit enemies have updated behavior, keeping you on your toes
 Shortened respawn time in single-player mode for a smoother experience
 New stamina bar look: sleeker and easier to track your energy
[/olist]
☢️ Flashlight Overhaul:
[olist]
 A brand-new flashlight design to light your way through the Backrooms
[/olist]
☢️ Research Underground Updates:
[olist]
 A gruesome new look for the corpse
[/olist]
☢️ Storytelling:
[olist]
 Added notes scattered throughout the levels—uncover the fate of the previous expedition
[/olist]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/ac3fec8c2dbb2042aa3c49ab5d425244ad9a4c1d.png

📝 Weekly Devlogs
Don't forget to check the devlogs! I’m sharing them weekly to keep you updated on what’s happening behind the scenes and what’s coming next.

🤔 Share Your Thoughts
I’d love to hear what you think about the latest changes! Your feedback is incredibly valuable, so drop a comment or join our Discord server to chat directly with me and the community.

See you in the Backrooms!

— Patrik

notes.title: A new update is out!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Patrik here. I’ve been reading all of your comments and reviews, and it really means a lot to me. I want to make sure the game meets your expectations, so here’s some quick info on what’s going on behind the scenes.
First off, there’s a new update waiting for you!

⭐ What’s New?
This time, I wanted to focus on the first two levels. Here’s what’s been fixed and added:

☢️ Uplifting of Level0:
[olist]
 Changed lighting
 Updated textures and models of the environment
 Updated layout of walls and columns
 Entities now can’t get stuck at the last doors, preventing players from entering
 Fixed issue with popping up walls[/olist]
☢️ New, scarier Smiler on Level0:
[olist]
 Updated look (check the gif below) 🔥
 New behaviour ⚠️[/olist]
☢️ New SFX:
[olist]
 Added ambient sounds to Research Underground
 Updated sounds of doors and levers on Research Underground
 Added music when interacting with specific places on Research Underground
 Added ambient water sound to main menu[/olist]
☢️ Fixed doors so they now close when players are out of range in Research Underground

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779997/83d0028245a6fff261e8c63592885b552c8429fc.gif
It's waiting in the shadows...

🔧 Fixing and Polishing First
My main focus right now is fixing and polishing what’s already in the game. I want to make sure you’re happy with the current experience before I jump into adding new levels and features. Because of this, the Halloween update and the new levels planned for October will need to be delayed—but don’t worry, they’ll be released eventually! I just want to make sure everything is in great shape before introducing more content.

📝 Weekly Devlogs
To keep you in the loop, I’ll be posting weekly devlogs from now on, giving you updates on what I’m working on and what’s coming next. I want to make sure you know exactly what’s happening and hear your thoughts on the upcoming changes!

🤔 Your Feedback is Super Important!
Please let me know what you think of these changes! I want to make sure the improvements are heading in the right direction, so your thoughts are really valuable. Drop your feedback in the comments or join our Discord server to chat with the community and me directly.

Thanks again for all your support! I’m really excited to continue improving Backrooms Media and make it a game we’re all proud of 😄

See you in the Backrooms!

— Patrik
